newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real dips 0.02 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real dips 0.02 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.02 percent to close at 1.0767 per dollar in calm traidng in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The current large stock of dollars maintained by some banks was reducing volatility in the forex market, they added.
The banks should hold dollars until the Central Bank lowers the reais-dollar mini-band, which is expected to happen in the next few days, dealers said.
The current mini-band was set on Monday at between 1.0765 and 1.0815 reais per greenback.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0823 per dollar, down 0.01 percent.
In the parallel market, the real dropped 0.18 percent to end at 1.140 per dollar, traders said.
